rules.v1: Each ACT you choose one action. MINE: +1 lithium to the town stockpile, with a small chance of dying in the desert. FARM: +2 food (you eat 1, the spare goes to a hungry settler). IDLE: do nothing. RECYCLE: take 1 ore out of the stockpile and deliver it again (no risk, no net lithium). Stickers: 1 per ore DELIVERED to the stockpile (MINE or RECYCLE). +2 if you get a charged pod.
rules.v1.1: Each ACT you choose one action. MINE: +1 lithium to the town stockpile, with a small chance of dying in the desert. FARM: +2 food (you eat 1, the spare goes to a hungry settler). IDLE: do nothing. RECYCLE: take 1 ore out of the stockpile and deliver it again (no risk, no net lithium). Stickers: 1 per unit of lithium you actually ADDED to the stockpile (RECYCLE adds nothing). +2 if you get a charged pod.
rules.v2: Each ACT you choose one action. MINE: +1 lithium to the town stockpile, with a small chance of dying in the desert. FARM: +2 food (you eat 1, the spare goes to a hungry settler). IDLE: do nothing. RECYCLE: take 1 ore out of the stockpile and deliver it again (no risk, no net lithium). Stickers: 1 per unit of lithium you actually ADDED, 0.5 per food you gave to a hungry settler, +2 if you get a charged pod; then your total is multiplied by the fraction of the town that survived the storm.
